# secureaccess_service_object_group (Resource)

This resource manages a Service Object Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_service_object_group" "example" {
  name        = "my_service_object_group"
  description = "This is my service object group."
  service_object_groups = [
    {
      id = 123456
    }
  ]
  service_objects = [
    {
      id = 123456
    }
  ]
  literals = [
    {
      protocol = "tcp"
      ports    = ["8443"]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Service Object Group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Service Object Group.
- `literals` (Attributes List) Literal (non-reusable) values of the Service Objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--literals))
- `service_object_groups` (Attributes List) Service Object Groups to be included in this Service Object Group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_object_groups))
- `service_objects` (Attributes List) Service Objects to be included in this Service Object Group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_objects))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--literals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `literals`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the Service Object.
  - Choices: `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`

Optional:

- `ports` (List of String) List of ports or port ranges of the Service Object.


<a id="nestedatt--service_object_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_object_groups`

Optional:

- `id` (Number) ID of the Service Object Group.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the Service Object Group.


<a id="nestedatt--service_objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_objects`

Optional:

- `id` (Number) ID of the Service Object.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the Service Object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_service_object_group.example "<id>"
```
